CAU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CAU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at CAU?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at Central Agricultural University is scheduled for 14 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture/Horticulture, Botany/Microbiology/Biotechnology from a recognized university. Experience in mushroom cultivation and laboratory work is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years. However, relaxations are provided for SC/ST/Women candidates and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Assistant position at CAU?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview with their bio-data and required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the College of Fisheries, Central Agricultural University, Lembucherra, Tripura, PIN 799210.

faq.question: Q7. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their bio-data, original documents, and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, along with a recent passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is purely on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I contact for further queries regarding the CAU recruitment?
faq.answer: For any further queries, it is advisable to refer to the official website of the Central Agricultural University or contact the recruitment cell mentioned in the official notification.
